columns.name: SourceOutcomeSetId
columns.description: ID of the org level outcome set used to create this outcome set. Field will be null if it is the primary outcome set.

columns.name: IsPrimary
columns.description: Flag showing if this Outcome Set is associated with 'My Learning Outcomes' (the course-specific outcome set).

columns.name: CreatedDate
columns.description: Date when this item was initially created (UTC). Field can be null. Will always be null for the 'My Learning Outcomes' outcome set.

columns.name: CreatedBy
columns.description: ID of the user who initially created this item. Field can be null.

columns.name: LastModifiedDate
columns.description: Date when this item was last modified (UTC). Contains created date upon creation and deleted date for deleted items.

columns.name: LastModifiedBy
columns.description: ID of the user who last modified, created, or deleted this item. Field can be null.

columns.name: IsDeleted
columns.description: Indicates whether this item has been deleted.

columns.name: ScaleId
columns.description: ID of the scale that is attached to the course level outcome set. Field can be null.

columns.name: AchievementThreshold
columns.description: Level ID representing the level of achievement for this course level outcome set. Field can be null.
